The model proposal is not authority. Local and remote controls combine as distinct conditions, not as a chain of substitutes.

replacements.Cómo se compone la autoridad antes de qu: How authority composes before a coding agent produces an external effect
replacements.El contexto no confiable puede influir e: Untrusted context can influence the model proposal, but the harness creates a canonical request. Four independent signals—tool and schema, policy, bound approval, and sandbox with network—converge at a local gate. If the reviewed request changes, its digest no longer matches and the action returns to approval. The resulting invocation then crosses into the external domain, where credential and ACL or IAM converge at a second gate. Only then can an effect occur. Denials, rejections, and effects leave auditable evidence without logging secrets.
replacements.C(a) y R(a) son autoridad del destino, n: C(a) and R(a) are destination authority, not sandbox authority
replacements.request digest · policy/rule · approval: request digest · policy/rule · approval · identity/scopes · sandbox/network · result · verification_head_sha
replacements.registra decisiones y efectos; nunca el: records decisions and effects; never the secret value
replacements.T, P, A y S son controles locales difere: T, P, A, and S are distinct local controls; C and R belong to the remote domain. Approval does not widen the sandbox, the sandbox does not narrow a remote credential's scopes, and any change to the reviewed request invalidates its bound approval. Every outcome must leave enough evidence to reconstruct effective authority.
